title: Compassion and Care
text: Home / Compassion and Care COMPASSION & CARE Compassion and Care Ministries Short-term Missions → Field Missions → Field Support → Mission Mobilization → Compassion and Care → Local Outreach → Prayer and Fellowship → TOGETHER IN PRAYER Prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer. Read the prayer calendar → Compassion and Care One of CMI Canada’s purposes is to bear witness to Jesus Christ through the whole gospel, guided by the great commandment to love God and our neighbours. CMI Canada seeks to be a bridge between supporting churches and mission fields, bringing love to people in need: • Financial support for teaching and gospel work in impoverished rural communities. • Financial support for local preachers in the field, enabling them to devote themselves to serving the Lord. • Financial support for the schooling of local preachers’ children. title: Field Support
text: Home / Field Support FIELD SUPPORT Field Support Ministries Short-term Missions → Field Missions → Field Support → Mission Mobilization → Compassion and Care → Local Outreach → Prayer and Fellowship → TOGETHER IN PRAYER Prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer. Read the prayer calendar → Field Support As a sending base, CMI Canada works closely with mission fields to develop and advance the work there: Financial support: Living expenses and ministry needs of our two current missionaries. Support for the Bilaga Youth Gospel Centre and dormitory ministry. CMI Canada provides living expenses for two local preachers so they can focus on serving students. The dormitories are almost free for students from poor families, so supporting churches also help meet operating costs. Holy Mountain Church: the financial needs of local workers and the worship and education centre under construction. Financial support for local preachers, enabling them to devote themselves to serving the Lord. Support through prayer and care: We regularly share prayer needs from the field so everyone can pray for them. We also hold a monthly prayer meeting and welcome you to join us. We maintain contact with missionaries and local workers in the field and attend to their needs.

title: About CMI International
text: Home / About CMI International ABOUT CMI About CMI International About Us About CMI International → About CMI Canada → Statement of Faith → CMI Around the World → TOGETHER IN PRAYER Prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer. Read the prayer calendar → Care Ministries International Care Ministries International Care Ministries International (CMI) was founded by Pastor 李秀全. It first registered with the Hong Kong government in 1997 under the name Care Society, then formally established operations in the United States in 2001. It is an interdenominational Chinese-speaking faith mission agency focused on cross-cultural missions. Mission Vision “The gospel to China; the gospel from China” is CMI’s vision. Through ministry into China, we move toward sending the gospel out from China. Through full-time and professional service, based on the whole Bible, we mobilize the whole church to bring the whole gospel to the whole world. Core Values Care expresses Christ’s love for us and our love for China. The four letters of CARE convey CMI’s ministry priorities: C: CHRIST CENTEREDNESS — Christ at the centre. A: ATONEMENT — redemption as the way. R: RECONCILIATION — reconciliation as the purpose. E: EVANGELIZATION — missions as the calling. Mission Strategies In response to the needs of the field, CMI sends long-term, professional, tentmaking, short-term, and associate missionaries to serve through compassion, medical care, education, evangelism, and training, bearing witness to the gospel and nurturing communities of Christ’s disciples. Mission Fields Since its founding, CMI has sent missionaries from Taiwan, the United States, Canada, New Zealand, and restricted-access regions to serve cross-culturally in Thailand, Cambodia, and restricted-access fields. It also supports gospel work among ethnic minority groups in Myanmar. In recent years, it has actively explored ministry in Japan and other countries. Sending Bases CMI has established regional offices in the United States, Taiwan, New Zealand, Australia, Canada, Japan, and restricted-access regions. These serve as bases for recruiting, training, and sending missionaries. Main Ministries Mission mobilization: mobilizing, equipping, and calling disciples to become missionaries. Through different approaches, they pioneer ministries, share the gospel, establish churches, and train disciples of Jesus Christ in the field to fulfil the Great Commission. Mission prayer: guided by “missions and prayer” and “prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer,” CMI calls partners to pray for missions, establishes monthly prayer fellowships, and holds annual mission prayer conferences in the western and southeastern United States and Taiwan. Missionary care: establishing missionary care fellowships and encouraging care throughout a missionary’s service, from recruitment to retirement. Mission education: in partnership with seminaries, CMI offers six-to-eight-week summer Mission Field Training (MFT), emphasizing cross-cultural practice and training in the field. Partners have included Logos Evangelical Seminary in the United States and Taiwan’s China Evangelical Seminary, Lutheran Theological Seminary, Disciple Training Theological Seminary, Central Taiwan Theological Seminary, Holy Light Theological Seminary, Truth Theological Seminary, Alliance Theological Seminary, Baptist Theological Seminary, and a seminary in a restricted-access region. A hundred participants have completed MFT, with numbers increasing each year. Several now serve in mission fields; others have returned home after two years of short-term service. Medical outreach: medical professionals visit Cambodia each year, serving physical needs as a way to minister to spiritual needs. Rapha Institute: developing a nursing institute in Cambodia to train local Christian nursing professionals and help the gospel take root among the people of Cambodia. Chinese-language teaching: sending missionaries to teach Chinese at universities or secondary schools while sharing the gospel, leading people to Christ, and training disciples of Jesus Christ. Mission Funding CMI is a faith mission agency. Its funding comes through God’s grace, expressed in the support and giving of brothers, sisters, and churches.

title: Statement of Faith
text: Home / Statement of Faith ABOUT CMI Statement of Faith About Us About CMI International → About CMI Canada → Statement of Faith → CMI Around the World → TOGETHER IN PRAYER Prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer. Read the prayer calendar → Statement of Faith Statement of Faith We believe: 1. The Bible The Old and New Testaments are inspired by God and record His complete revelation of salvation for humanity. They are the highest authority for Christian faith and life. 2. God God is self-existent and eternal: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, eternally one God in three persons. He creates, sustains, and governs the universe and all things. 3. Christ Jesus Christ is the only Son of God, fully divine and fully human. Sent by the Father, conceived by the Holy Spirit, and born of the virgin Mary, He was crucified, bodily resurrected, and ascended to sit at the right hand of the Most High. He is God’s anointed prophet, priest, and king. At the last day, Christ will personally return to judge the living and the dead. 4. The Holy Spirit The Holy Spirit is equal in honour and glory with the Father and the Son. He exalts Christ, guides us into all truth, and convicts the world concerning sin, righteousness, and judgment. He sanctifies people and empowers them to be witnesses of Jesus Christ. 5. Humanity Human beings were made in God’s image but fell into sin through rebellion and need God’s salvation. Through regeneration by the Holy Spirit and justification by faith in Jesus Christ, they are reconciled to God. All believers are priests, called to equip the saints, fulfil their ministries, and build up the body of Christ. 6. Redemption The blood, substitutionary death, and resurrection of Jesus Christ are the sole foundation of our justification and redemption. Only those who believe in and receive Jesus Christ are born anew through the Holy Spirit and become children of God. 7. The Church The church is the body of Christ, with Christ as its head, uniting all believers born anew through the Holy Spirit. Through worship, discipleship, fellowship, service, and witness, it fulfils the Great Commission. 8. Missions Our God is a missionary God. The Holy Spirit mobilizes the whole church, based on the whole Bible, to proclaim the whole gospel to the ends of the earth until the Lord returns. 9. We believe the Bible clearly teaches that marriage, established by God, is the union of one man and one woman. Enlarge to Read ⤢

title: Field Missions
text: Home / Field Missions MISSIONS IN THE FIELD Field Missions Ministries Short-term Missions → Field Missions → Field Support → Mission Mobilization → Compassion and Care → Local Outreach → Prayer and Fellowship → TOGETHER IN PRAYER Prayer is the root of missions; missions are the fruit of prayer. Read the prayer calendar → Field Missions CMI Canada currently has two missionaries, 盛行楚 and 李愛珍, who serve as a married couple in Cambodia. Their dedicated service for the Lord has borne abundant fruit. Working with other missionaries and local workers to advance the gospel, they lead or assist the following ministries: Dormitory ministry: three dormitories focus on discipleship, welcoming university students and sharing the gospel with them. Two local pastors supported by CMI Canada also lead students in outreach elsewhere. Bilaga Youth Gospel Centre: a place for current students and alumni to worship and fellowship, and a church established through the dormitory ministry. Holy Mountain Church: a remote rural church in Pursat Province, established through repeated evangelistic outreach by dormitory ministry workers under the leadership of CMI missionaries. A missionary couple from Canada serves there alongside local workers. CMI Canada is developing a worship and education centre at Holy Mountain, combining missions, poverty relief, and education to serve impoverished villages. Children’s education: Chinese, English, and Bible story classes at the CMI office in Phnom Penh and nearby villages share the gospel with local children. The two missionaries also serve as Cambodia field directors, receive short-term and visiting mission teams, care for local workers, and undertake poverty relief and other work.
